Quantum Riddler is a 4/6 flyer that draws a card on ETB (and has the bonus draw ability with low hand size), making it a far superior copy target. Sunpearl Kirin is a 2/1 flyer whose ETB bounces one of your own nonland permanents — which is actively bad here since GPT52 Hype has no tokens or permanents worth bouncing. The Spider-Man becomes a 4/4 regardless, but copying Quantum Riddler gives flying + card draw + potential future card advantage, while copying Sunpearl Kirin gives flying + a mostly useless/detrimental bounce ability.
annotations.actionTaken: Copied Sunpearl Kirin with Superior Spider-Man, getting a 4/4 flyer with a bounce-your-own-permanent ETB trigger.
annotations.betterLine: Copy Quantum Riddler to get a 4/4 flyer that draws a card on ETB and has the bonus draw ability when at one or fewer cards in hand, providing significantly more value.

annotations.description: Cast Nowhere to Run with no opposing creatures on the battlefield, completely wasting its -3/-3 ETB removal effect. The only benefit is a prowess trigger on the Otter Token for +1/+1 until end of turn. Nowhere to Run is a valuable removal spell that should be saved for when the opponent deploys a threat. Additionally, a land should have been played first before casting spells.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Nowhere to Run targeting nothing (no opposing creatures), wasting the removal ETB for just a prowess trigger.
annotations.betterLine: Play a land (Concealed Courtyard or Watery Grave), then cast Stormchaser's Talent (or Grim Bauble for another prowess trigger with upside), and hold Nowhere to Run as removal for when the opponent plays a creature.

annotations.description: Concealed Courtyard enters tapped since they control 5 other lands, giving no mana this turn. Watery Grave could enter untapped (paying 2 life) to provide B or U mana, enabling casting Grim Bauble or holding up Sunpearl Kirin (1W flash) with Hallowed Fountain.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Concealed Courtyard, which entered tapped, leaving only 1 untapped land (Hallowed Fountain).
annotations.betterLine: Play Watery Grave (paying 2 life) to have 2 untapped lands, enabling Grim Bauble deployment or holding up Sunpearl Kirin as a flash threat.

annotations.description: Chose to destroy a 1/1 Otter Token instead of the more threatening 2/1 Sunpearl Kirin with flash and flying. This results in taking 1 extra damage this combat (3 instead of 2) and leaves the stronger, evasive creature on the battlefield.

annotations.betterLine: Use Bitter Triumph to destroy Sunpearl Kirin (2/1 flash flyer with bounce ETB), saving 1 more damage and removing the more threatening permanent

annotations.description: Chose to destroy a 1/1 Otter Token instead of the 2/1 flying Sunpearl Kirin. The Kirin deals more damage per turn, has evasion (flying), and has a useful ETB bounce ability if it gets re-cast or blinked. Removing the Kirin would save 1 additional damage per combat step and eliminate the more strategically dangerous creature.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted an Otter Token with Bitter Triumph, leaving Sunpearl Kirin and another Otter Token alive to deal 4 total combat damage.
annotations.betterLine: Target Sunpearl Kirin with Bitter Triumph to remove the flying 2-power threat, taking only 2 damage from the two Otter Tokens instead of 4 from Kirin + Otter.

annotations.description: Chose to destroy an Otter Token (1/1 prowess) instead of Sunpearl Kirin (2/1 flying with bounce ETB). Sunpearl Kirin deals more damage, has evasion (flying), and has a disruptive ability. With GPT52 Hype at 10 life and no creatures on board, removing the bigger threat with evasion would have been more impactful.

annotations.betterLine: Target Sunpearl Kirin with Bitter Triumph, as it's the highest-impact creature on the board with flying evasion and a bounce ability

annotations.description: Sunpearl Kirin is a 2/1 flyer that deals consistent evasive damage, and GPT52 Hype has no flyers to block it. At 10 life, taking 2 unblockable damage per turn is more threatening than a 1/1 prowess Otter token. The Kirin also has flash utility if bounced and replayed.
